resume-analyzer.description:
AI-powered resume screening tool — upload up to 3 PDF resumes, specify a job position and requirements, and get per-candidate suitability scores, skill gap analysis, recruiter advice, and suggested interview questions. Includes a side-by-side candidate comparison report ranked by suitability score with strengths, weaknesses, and a final hiring recommendation. Built with Next.js and .NET Core.
* All names and data shown in screenshots are fictional and for demonstration purposes only

sales-analyzer.description: AI-powered sales analytics platform — query products in natural language and let the AI extract filters (keyword, category, price range, rating) to search the database instantly. Features include AI-driven product ranking that scores and ranks items by ratings, review volume, and sentiment; per-product review summaries with average rating breakdowns; similar product recommendations; and a full-catalog insights dashboard surfacing top-performing brands, underperforming products, category gaps, and pricing recommendations. AI responses stream in real-time via SSE. Built with a Go (chi) backend, PostgreSQL database, Next.js frontend, and LLM calls routed through OpenRouter.

personal-financial-agent.description: Personal financial advisory agent — tracks income, expenses, and gives AI-powered financial insights. Go backend API with a Next.js frontend.
